summary: Doc/code drift sweep over 17 own-dashboard docs and 2 quorum docs at 8df25a5/76314a3. 18 findings, every one citing the doc line and the code line. Three could mislead the owner into a wrong action: the migration guide claims repository and production versions match and points to repair commands that do not exist (24 production-only and 20 repo-only versions, plus restrict_pg_net_browser_roles with no file), so the next db push fails or a careless repair re-applies 20 migrations; quorum NEEDED.md proposes cancelling the "unused" Apify subscription that OwnDashboard Instagram collection and the $150 credit depend on; own-dashboard NEEDED.md keeps retired staging/n8n/BoardlessAI items, one asking for Insights access, and says waiting briefs get jobs after verification when they lapse first. Other drift: retention and the cron prune described as live (production lacks both; the daily tick logs scheduler-state-unavailable), .env.example defaults the feed provider to the retired Quorum bridge, the worker README describes an n8n-called external worker, the weekly-operations doc is unmarked history, dneskai-source-media.md:28-29 is still stale (PR #126 fixed only marketing-revision-media.md:28,45), and smaller wording drifts. Verified consistent: the vendored studio pin equals quorum studio at 76314a3; marketing-launch.md and marketing-n8n.md are bannered as historical; marketing-render-preflight.md and UPSTREAM.md match code.
